parsed.why: Hostile state: adult bathroom restriction in many state facilities, no gender-identity anti-discrimination law, hate-crime law excludes gender identity, birth-marker ban. No enforcement incident, but tier-1 facility exposure and hostile climate under parent border regime.

Explicit gender-identity protections with enforced commission remedies, no bathroom ban, accessible ID markers, city sanctuary shielding care travellers. State hate-crime gap and pending sports bills, but local regime substantially protective; parent border caps score.

Low-risk legal assessment but national seat: national legislature's facility ban applies directly, can be overridden by national action, protest arrests documented; no local protection details. Parent regime fully operative, offset by no local bathroom ban.

School-only bathroom restriction and care ban, birth-marker surgery rule: mostly resident-facing. No adult facility ban, but patchy municipal protections, hate-crime exclusion and religious-refusal law leave thin visitor recourse; parent border caps.

Strong public-accommodation and hate-crime protections, self-declared ID markers, health-care shield, Most Protective ranking. Unrepealed but unenforced sodomy statute is minor tangential drag; parent border and custody regime cap score.
